entries.def:
ἐν-δοξάζω 
[in LXX for כָּבַד ni., Exo.14.4, 17-18, Ezk.28.22, etc.; for עָרַץ, Psa.89.7 Sir.38.6, al. ;] 
to glorify: pass., 2Th.1.10-12.†
(AS)

ἔνδοξος, -ον
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;] 
__1. held in honour, of high repute: 1Co.4.10. 
__2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., Luk.13.17 of clothing, Luk.7.25. Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, Eph.5.27 (cf. παράδοξος).†
(AS)

ἔνδυμα, -τος, τό
(ἐνω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ ;] 
raiment, clothing, a garment: Mat.3.4; 6.25, 28; 7.15; 22.11-12; 28.3, Luk.12.23.†
(AS)

ἐν-δυναμόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Jdg.6.34, 1Ch.12.18 A (לָבַשׁ), Psa.52.7 (עָזַז)* ;] 
to make strong, strengthen: with accusative, of person(s), Php.4.13, 1Ti.1.12, 2Ti.4.17. Pass., Act.9.22 C. dative, Rom.4.20 before ἐν, 2Ti.2.1 (ἐν Κυρίῳ), Eph.6.10 (Cremer, 221).†
(AS)

ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω.
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Ti.3.6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), Mat.27.28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mat.27.31, Mrk.15.20, Luk.15.22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6.25, Mrk.6.9, Luk.8.27; 12.22, Act.12.21; ptcp., Mat.22.11, Mrk.1.6, 2Co.5.3, Rev.1.13; 15.6; 19.14; of armour (figuratively): Rom.13.12,…

ἔν-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδύω), [in LXX: Job.41.13 (לְבוּשׁ), Est.5.1 * ;] 
a putting on: ίματίων, 1Pe.3.3.†
(AS)

ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2Ti.3.6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), Mat.27.28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Mat.27.31, Mrk.15.20, Luk.15.22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6.25, Mrk.6.9, Luk.8.27; 12.22, Act.12.21; ptcp., Mat.22.11, Mrk.1.6, 2Co.5.3, Rev.1.13; 15.6; 19.14; of armour (figuratively): Rom.13.12, Eph.6.11, 14, 1Th.5.8;…

ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Jos.8.7-9, Psa.10.8 (אָרַב)* ;] 
a lying in wait, an ambush: Act.23.16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), Act.25.8.†
(AS)

ἐνεδρεύω
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;] 
to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luk.11.54, Act.23.21.†
(AS)

ἔνεδρον, -ου, τό, see: ἐνέδρα.
ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Jos.8.7-9, Psa.10.8 (אָרַב)* ;] 
a lying in wait, an ambush: Act.23.16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), Act.25.8.†
(AS)
